purpose: Canonical relationship index for repository work-entry methods, event triggers, admission/routing, workflows, effects, and evidence feeds. Existing specialized registries and generated catalogs remain authoritative for their own domains.

authority.repository_truth: GitHub issues, pull requests, comments, labels, refs, workflow runs, jobs, artifacts, and commits.
authority.labels: GitHub repository labels; semantic interpretation remains distributed across owning workflow/template contracts.
authority.role_identity: AGENT-MONIKERS / role references and authored MUSEai stamps; role identity alone does not imply dispatch.
authority.dashboard_projection: SHE read-only projections and surface feeds; dashboard is not a dispatch authority or database.

sources.freshness: generated; refresh through existing automation-docs lane

sources.role: canonical issue filing → QUE admission contract
dashboard ownership and feed consumer map
filing → admission → route → build → publish chain
source-derived inventory of all YAML issue forms, labels, titles, and dispatch declarations
source-verified selected workflow event and selector census
sources.scope: eight source-verified exemplars; one additional workflow reconciles directory/catalog drift

sources.role: catalog-level workflow event, schedule, job, authority, concurrency, and action-pin snapshot; source-level v2 enrichment is generated by the workflow YAML parser
sources.refresh: Generated v2 snapshot is produced by the trusted master refresh after this generator lands

sources.role: source-verified comment mentions, slash commands, provider commands, and HTML marker selectors

concepts.description: Human-facing GitHub issue form or Markdown template that collects structured intake.
concepts.declaration: A template dispatches only when it contains a valid SWARM-DISPATCH block; filing alone is not blanket authorization.

concepts.description: Issue lifecycle event consumed by workflows; exact activity types are workflow-specific.
Comment event used by workflow-specific command, marker, or bot-feedback handlers.
Label changes can select a route when a workflow explicitly subscribes and validates the label. Labels are also classification/admission signals.
PR lifecycle and path-filtered validation/automation; activity types are workflow-specific.
Review submission and inline review-comment events; used by feedback and review automation.
Explicit operator-initiated workflow run with declared inputs.
Downstream workflow initiation after a named upstream workflow reaches a configured conclusion.
Reusable workflow invocation by a caller workflow; execution context and provenance belong to caller/callee contract.
External or internal repository event with a typed event_type and client payload.
Branch/ref update trigger, usually scoped by branches and paths.
Provider-specific completion or webhook bridge. Record concrete provider and payload contract per workflow.

interaction_signals.dispatch_behavior: A label is executable only where a workflow explicitly subscribes to its event or a filing contract maps it to a route.
Treat as an identity/provenance stamp. A workflow-specific parser must explicitly consume it before it can act as a trigger.
Workflow-specific mention detection; Jules on Issues is catalogued as listening to issue_comment and issues events.

interaction_signals.syntax: workflow-specific slash command or HTML marker
interaction_signals.dispatch_behavior: A handler must define parser, authorization, dedupe key, and receipt.

admission.receipt: First fleet comment on the filing; includes decision and admission evidence.
admission.invariant: Issue template dispatch reaches the swarm only through QUE admission. Deferral preserves the issue in the queue for later re-evaluation.

routes.status: CONFIRMED; exact selector logic remains in workflow source

routes.entry: research issue templates and repository signals
routes.trigger: workflow-specific issue, PR, schedule, workflow_dispatch, workflow_run

routes.route: project-task-dispatch.yml → QDesk claim → build-dispatch.yml → per-surface publish workflow

workflow_event_catalog.rule: Use the generated catalog for exhaustive per-workflow inventory; this registry stores normalized relationships and selected exemplars rather than copying 332 rows.

feed_contract.refresh: Consume existing generated workflow catalog and surface feeds; preserve each feed's generated_at/source SHA/freshness contract.
feed_contract.privacy: Store references and bounded metadata. Exclude credentials, prompt/completion bodies, arbitrary comment bodies, and raw provider payloads unless a separate reviewed schema explicitly allows a field.
feed_contract.authority: Read-only projection; GitHub and owning workflow artifacts remain authoritative.

reconciliation_rules: One stable ID per method, trigger, selector, route, workflow, and feed.
Keep event type separate from activity type, selector, and admission decision.
Keep labels as typed signals; one label may classify, route, or record state depending on its owning contract.
Keep role/mention identity separate from executable command semantics.
Keep issue-template filing separate from the GitHub issues event that wakes the workflow.
A workflow's catalog authority class describes its write posture; it does not prove a particular run succeeded.
Preserve source paths, source SHA/fingerprint, timestamps, and evidence links.
Unknown mappings remain UNKNOWN and become explicit reconciliation work.
known_gaps: Complete repository label census and each label's consumer workflow are not embedded; GitHub labels plus owning workflow contracts remain authoritative.
All @mention spellings, slash commands, and HTML comment markers have not been exhaustively extracted.

Event payload schemas and cross-workflow handoff artifact contracts remain to be normalized; workflow YAML parsing now captures event filters, activity types, dispatch inputs, permissions, job selectors, concurrency, action references, and source blob provenance.
Existing feed schemas and refresh cadence vary by surface; map each surface to its exact feed contract during the next reconciliation pass.

steps: parse all workflow on/activity filters and selector expressions
join workflows to generated feeds and dashboard surfaces
emit deterministic validation report and freshness receipt

workflow_authority_conflicts.reason: Source executes a GitHub REST PATCH to change an external repository visibility and verifies the result.
